notes.title: Aspects
notes.content:
Reintroduced Trials as "Aspects". Aspects are 0 mana cards that gives their owner permanent advantage and disadvantage. Like trials they are also added to the starting hand as a 6'th card. If the player players any card before the Aspect, the Aspect will automatically activate.

The following Aspects has been created.
[list]
[*] Mythron Wanderer
[*] Hatefurnace
[*] Underlord Xorxuul
[*] Grand Strategos
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43485418/5ff5f4babb3a9546d0145210d7358f5b39111ce2.png[/img]

notes.title: 20th August 2024 - patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a visual indicator when selecting a Ranged unit to show it's range on the board.
[*] Introduced "Reach". Spell, opening gambit and ability effects now all have a "Reach". It is similiar to ranged in that it limits how far you can target them. It is indicated by a number on a little eye icon infront of the relevant effect text. It is also shown on the board when selecting a spell/ability or summoning a minion with an opening gambit.
[*] The origin of spells will always be your general. The origin of abilities and opening gambits will be the minion.
[*] As a side effect Twilight Sorcerer will now use BBS's abilities relative to himself (as if he was the general).
[*] The text for many BBS spells and opening gambit's are changed to remove "nearby" or "adjacent" since those can now be indicated by reach.
[*] By default all existing spells, opening gambits and abilities that had targeted global range effects now have infinite reach (indicated by a infinity symbol over the eye icon)
[*] Gotatsu's Reach reduced to 2.
[*] Phoenix Fire Reach reduced to 3.
[*] Thunderbomb reach reduced to 3.
[*] Faie Bloodwing BBS reach reduced to 3.
[*] Ritual Banishing reach reduced to 4.
[*] Ghost Lynx, Keeper of the Value, Omniseer and Blood Baronette opening gambit reach increased from 0 (wich is nearby) to 1.
[*] Omniseer can now target the tile it is summoned on.
[*] Azure Summoning mana discount reduced from 2 to 1.
[*] Denadoro stats reduced from 4/5 to 3/4.
[/list]

notes.title: 1st August 2024- BIG patch
notes.content:
We have made huge changes. We've nerfed all removal, Changed the ranged keyword and creep tiles, reworked a bunch of underplayed cards into new ones and balanced a lot more. We removed a few cards, most notably the trial cards, and increased the maximum hand size to 7. 

We want to make the game more focused on the board and positioning of minions. This means nerfing some "answer or die" cards too since most of the removal is also nerfed. 

Here're the full patch notes:

[list]
[*] Ranged minions attack range is now limited depending on the strength of the Ranged keyword. Most ranged minions are Ranged (2), some have more. Small stat increases have been givin to certain ranged minions.
[*] Widowmaker now has equipment (Blacksteel Glave) that gives Range (2)
[*] Ephemeral Shroud mana cost increased from 2 to 3 and attack from 1 to 2.
[*] Reworked Plasma Storm. It now gives all minions Grow -2/-2
[*] EMP openging gambit changed to Ability 0.
[*] Blood of air. Removed the increasing mana cost effect. Mana cost increased from 5 to 6.
[*] Reworked Unstable Leviathan. It is now a 5 mana 12/12 that has Grow -3/-3 wich cannot be dispelled.
[*] Bloodtide Priestess now only summons wraithlings adjacent. Attack increased from 3 to 4.
[*] New Keyword: Echo. When a card with Echo is played from your hand, a copy of that card is imediatly added to your hand but the Echo keyword is removed.
[*] Dauntless Advance, Blind Scorch, Auryn Nexus, Auroraboros gains Echo.
[*] Increased max hand size from 6 to 7.
[*] Reworked Huldra. It now costs 4 mana. It now has Ability 2:  Return a minion to it's owners hand. It gains Echo.
[*] Mana cost of all wall tokens reduced from 1 to 0. Gravity Well, Luminous Charge, Bonechill Barrier, Blazing Spines.
[*] Chittering Tiller opening gambit changed to: "Opening Gambit and Ability 1: Teleport the enemy General one space.". Note that it is one space in any direction as opposed to before where it was one space forward.
[*] Aperions Claim reworked. It now costs 6 mana. Now creates 3x3 hallowed ground. At the end of your opponents next turn kills any enemy minion standing on hallowed ground.
[*] Twilight Sorcerer reworked. "When this minion enters play it learns your Bloodbound Spell It can then cast it as Ability 1.". Mana cost also reduced from 5 to 4.
[*] Nightsorrow assassin reworked. it is now a 6 mana for a 5/5 that has "This minions mana cost is reduced by 1 for each minion killed during your turn."
[*] Golden Justicar rewokred. It is now a 5 mana, 5/5. It now has equipment (Justicar's Bastion) that gives Provoke, +3 Health and +1 movement.
[*] Decorated Enlistee reworked. It now has +2 Attack for each friendly minion nearby it.
[*] Sandburrower reworked. it's effect now reads "At the end of it's owners turn this minion deals 1 damage to and stuns the enemy minion infront of it."
[*] Gatekeeper's movement restriction now cannot be dispelled.
[*] Silverguard Knight now only has Provoke when he has Zeal.
[*] Reworked Dreadnaught. It is now a 4 mana 7/7 with Rebirth. It cannot move and this cannot be disppeled. It has an 2 mana Ability that allows it to move 1 space that doesnt exhaust it.
[*] Reworked Soboro. It is now a 2 mana 4/4 that has Echo and Opening Gambit: lose one mana crystal.
[*] Reworked Whisper of the Sands: It now transforms all friendly wind dervishes into Sand Howlers. It also has Echo.
[*] Reworked Azure Summoning. it now reads "Summon the highest mana cost minion from your deck. It costs 2 less and it returns to your hand at the end of your next turn";
[*] Swarmking Scarab. Damage reduced from 5 to 2.
[*] Cassava Soulreapers BBS now deals it's one damage at the end of the turn instead of imediatly.
[*] Whenever a tile would have overwritten an tile belonging to the other player, they are both destroyed instead. A visual indicator was added for this.
[*] Echoing Shriek reworked. now reads "Create a minor summoning circle under each friendly minion that dies this turn". It also has Echo.
[*] Wind Sister Maria now gives her +1/+1 buff to any friendly minion summoned on the opponents side of the field instead of friendly minions with infiltrate (this includes herself)
[*] Sand Sister Saon now gives your general Armour in addition to the +1 Attack.
[*] Juggernaut. Grow reduced from 5 to 2.
[*] Reworked wanderlust and changed name to Silent Intensity. for 1 mana. "Give a friendly minion +4 Attack during your opponents turn.". It also has Echo.
[*] Lionize. manacost reduced from 5 to 4. can now target any friendly minion (as opposed to friendly minion behind your genereal), but the minion cannot attack this turn.
[*] Skullprophet now gives your General +1 Attack in addition to taking 1 Attack away from the enemy General.
[*] Radiant Dragoon now gives a friendly random minion +2 health instead of +1. It also prioritizes the minion infront of it.
[*] Angered Okkadok, stats reduced to 0/1 from 1/2. intensify increased to +2/+2, up from +1/+1
[*] Spellshield now also blocks the Ability keyword from targeting an enemy minion. (It still wont block other minion effects like Opening Gambit)
[*] Reworked Dragonlark. it is now a 2 mana 0/2 with Celerity but it cant attack or counterattack. It creates Eruptive Eggs when it moves.
[*] Reworked Matron Elveiti. It is now a 5 mana 5/6. It has Infiltrate: All friendly minions on the oppoenents starting side gain +1/+1 at the end of each turn.
[*] Reworked Denadoro. It now reads. Infiltrate: Your General has Infiltrate: +1 Attack and Force Field.
[*] Reworked Lighting Blitz. It now has Echo and reads: Move an enemy minion up to 4 spaces backwards. 
[*] Shadowcreep now does 3 damage instead of 1 but it now triggers at the end of the opponents turn instead of the end of your turn.
[*] Abyssal Crawler will now prioritize the space in front if there is no tile on it.
[*] Abyssal Juggernaut now read. This minion has +2/+2 for each Shadow Creep nearby it at the start of the turn.
[*] Abyssal Tormentor reworked. it now reads: At the end of your turn, each nearby friendly Shadow Creep that has open space becomes a 3/2 Shadow Creeper.
[*] Kindling and Owlbeast sage now only affects nearby frienly arcanysts
[*] Maehv Skinsoldier BBS now longer deals damage to herself.
[*] Painfull pluck can now target any tile (that doesnt have influence on it) instead of being random.
[*] Scioness Sajj's BBS now also reduces all damage she takes this turn by 2.
[*] Shidai Stormblossom BBS changed to Murasame. Murasame now changes your BBS to Kiyomori, Kiyomori to Kotetsu, Kotetsu to Tonahashi and Tanahashi back to Murasame. Aditionally all the spellswords can now be replaced.
[*] Alabaster Titan is now 8 mana 4/6 instead of 7 mana 5/7.
[*] Ayamara Healer no longer deals damage when she dies.
[*] Boneswarm changed to deal damage around your General instead of around the enemy General.
[*] Gold Vitriol now only triggers from healing originating from a friendly source.
[*] Sunforge Lancer. Bonus damage Given to General is now an aura (Meaning the bonus damage will be lost if the Sungorge Lancer dies or gets dispelled etc. In addition the effect will only trigger on healing originating from a friendly source.
[*] Sunriser's effect now only triggers from healing originating from a friendly source.
[*] Sunrise Cleric. Health reduced from 3 to 2.
[*] Grandmaster Kraigon: Reduced the grow on itself and your General from +7/+7 to +2/+2.
[*] Makantor Warbeast: Health reduced from 4 to 2.
[*] Mist Dragon Seal bonus stats reduced from +1/+1 to +1/+0.
[*] Proginitor now targets up to 2 friendly minions instead of working on all friendly minions.
[*] Ragebinder attack reduced from 3 to 2.
[*] Ragnora the Relentless BBS. Rippers no longer have celerity but they may move 2 additional spaces.
[*] Astral Phasing. A minion affected by Astral Phasing can no longer damage Generals.
[*] Kinematic Projection. A minion affected by Kinematic Projection can no longer damage Generals.
[*] Reworked Darkspine Elemental. It now reads: Opening Gambit and Ability 0: Relocate up to 2 shadow creep.
[*] Kolosus. Grow reduced from +4/+4 to +3/+3.
[*] Moloki Huntress. Now only affects nearby friendly minions.
[*] Oropsisaur. Now only affects nearby friendly minions.
[*] Coalfist reworked. It now has Ability 1: Friendly minions in a 2x2 area gain +3 Attack until the start of your next turn.
[*] Reworked Twilight Fox. It now reads: Blood Surge: Teleport to the enemy General's starting column staying in the same row and gain +2 speed until the end of turn.
[*] Reworked Whiplash. it is now a 3/4 that reads: Opening Gambit and Ability 1: Deal 2 damage to anything.;
[*] Reworked Pupabomb. it now costs 3 mana and reads: Return all eggs to your hand. They gain echo.
[*] Eternity Painter, Sunset Paragon, Stars Fury, Saberspine Alpha, Necrotic Spere, Munch, Lost in the Desert, Inquisitor Kron, Hailstone Prison, Entropic Decay, Chromatic Cold, Circle of Life, Dark Transformation, Homeastatic Rebuke, Lightbender, Onyx Bear Seal, Bamboozle, Punish, Holy Immolation, Sunbloom, Natural Selection, Daemonic Lure, Aspect of the Ravager, Aspect of the Bear, Aspect of Shimzar, Decimate manacost increased by 1.
[*] Winters Wake, Obliterate, Ghost Azalea, Khanuumka, Wind Stopper, Rizen, Nimbus, Mnemovore, Lurking Fear, Grandmaster Nosh Rak, All 6 Trials, Flameing Stampede, Divine Bond, Divine Liturgy, Eclipse, Decimus, Evolutionary Apex, Carrion Collector has been removed from the game pending rework, nerf or reconsideration. 
[*] 3D versions of 2 of the arena's has been created, any battles that take place on those arena's will have a moveable camera.
[*] Splash screen with summary of patch changes will now show up once when the game starts.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch - January 10, 2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Better scaling and alignment for all unit sprites.
[*] Concealing Shroud now has a visible effect on the general.
[*] Improved pre-loading of sprites in the deck builder making going between pages smoother.
[*] Better alignment of ladder options (MMR limit etc).
[*] Added a little bit more margin to the left of card texts.
[*] Fixed continue button not working for ranked and gauntlet.
[*] Roguelike button renamed "Restart" to avoid potential confusion.
[*] Added general portraits in the deck builder list of decks.
[*] Prettier HD cancel button on the ladder search screen.
[*] Fixed units sometimes appearing on top of others when they're on a row "behind".
[*] Fixed an issue that often caused games against practice bots to end instantly.
[*] Fixed emotes setting not having proper initial value.
[*] Fixed a bug with Aperions Claim where it would still affect invulnerable Obelysks.
[*] Fixed an issue with Fate Seeker were it would behave weirdly if it died right as it got summoned.
[*] All eggs will now hatch at the same time.
[*] Equipment bearing minions will now gain their equipment at the start of the game instead of when they enter play. This means bouncing or cloning them will not ever yield more equipment. (If you bounce them now the equipment stays behind on the field and the minion goes to your hand without any equipment.)
[*] Fixed an issue with Mindlathe that made it not work if it was equipped through means other than playing it from your hand (e.g. via Droplift)
[*] Restored Abomination's old tooltip.
[*] fixed unit stats display when above 99 dmg and hp
[*] fixed Silver crashing the game when stacking ridiculous levels of Grow or Backstab
[*] fixed sprite alignment for manaforger, artifact hunter, windstopper
[*] fixed search cancel button not anchored to screen center
[*] Added a "Dispelled" visual indicator
[*] Battle log increased from 5 to 7 cards
[*] Added rarity icons on cards
[*] In deck builder, can search by rarity
[*] In deck builder, clicking a card just adds "Flat" cards to your deck if you're out of 3D cards
[*] In deck builder, improved card sets dropdown menus design
[*] Fixed mana cost being off-center in hand and mulligan for cards costing 10+
[*] Prettier card appearance in game, deck builder and gauntlet
[*] Added tooltips for Letigress, Spriggin, Skyshield Operator, Paleclaw Brawler, Hsuku, Grailmaster, Elkowl, Rook, Equipped, Blood Surge, Dispel, Stun, Trial&Destiny, Ability, and Sentinel
[*] Improved the looks of the default projectile sprite (ex: for Heartseeker, Grailmaster, Toiling Vassal)
[*] Added destination tile highlight to improve unit movement control (especially usefull for flying units).
[*] Fixed vertical Blast effect not properly angled with battlefield perspective
[*] Prettier icons on BBS spell cards
[*] Improved all deck builder text input fields
[*] Fixed "paste deck" & "new deck" button overlap in deck builder
[*] Fixed left-side enemy played card obstructing view with tooltips
[*] In the deck select screen before play, you can now right-click on buttons for fast forward and rewind 5 pages at a time
[*] The blue replace orb is now  greyed out during the opponent's turn
[*] Added some flavour text to certain cards.
[*] Searching cards now also considers tooltips (ex: searching for "rush" will include Letigress)
[*] Fixed game crashing in some Dispel situations.
[*] Fixed an issue with Savage Chain and Volatile Crystal where they got triggered by tiles created nearby and potentially crashing the game.
[*] Fixed an issue with Whispering Horn where flurries that were completely blocked from spawning could still spawn later after the Whispering Horn was destroyed.
[*] Fixed end screen "Build" button being disabled after a practice match against bot
[*] Fixed decklist card preview not using the updated card visuals.
[*] Fixed deckbuilder textfields not bringing up the mobile keyboard when selected.
[*] ensured a boss battle will always be there every week
[*] 3D cosmetic cards will now perform better on low end devices.
[*] Increased the thickness of 3D cosmetic cards.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause a match to slow down over time on low end devices.
[*] Added a playback speed button for replays
[*] Fixed BBS sprite scales looking too big in some places
[*] Fixed Paleclaw Gauntlet tile that can get hidden behind tall units
[*] Fixed Godhammer and Soul Grimwar having weird text
[*] Fix crash when pressing back on an empty decklist
[*] Fix deckbuilder back button resetting cards to page to 1
[*] In the deck list, faded background sprites are correctly scaled and positioned
[*] Fixed an issue that could lock up the client after a minion dies.
[*] mobile: bloom and lighting options are disabled by default to avoid lag and graphical glitches on certain lower-end devices (can still be enabled in options menu)
[*] mobile: fixed deckbuilder add/remove buttons overlapping with faction selectors
[*] mobile: fixed all known text card search and virtual keyboard issues in deck builder 
[/list]

BALANCE CHANGE

[list]
[*] Savage Chain: reduced damage dealt from 3 to 2.
[*] Skyshield (from Skyshield Operator) will now turn the wielder into a Mech in addition to reducing damage it takes by 1.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch - November 4, 2023
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in Underlord Xor'Xuul where the destiny effect could stop working if Underlord Xor'Xuul was converted.
[*] Spell damage boss reward in roguelike reduced from 4 to 3.
[*] Added 2 new hostile nodes to the roguelike

 BALANCE CHANGES

[*] Sun Elemental's ability can now target any friendly unit as opposed to only friendly nearby units.
[*] Master of Shadows stats changed from 3/2 to 2/4
[/list]

notes.content:
- Added option to Ladder for accurate matchmaking that will limit the difference between you and your opponent to 1000 MMR max at the cost of longer queue times.
- BALANCE CHANGE: Unbound Berserker's attack increased from 1 to 2

notes.title: Patch - February 6, 2023
notes.content:
- Added some game interface sounds when the player interacts with the cards and board.
- Created the custom games menu and inside it a menu option for the upcomming roguelike mode. The roguelike mode is not available yet.
- NEW CARD: Unbound Berserker - 3 mana Neutral minion.

notes.title: Patch - February 5, 2023
notes.content:
- Made UI buttons more interactive on Main menu, deck builder and profile screens (The same changes still need to be applied to other areas of the UI)
- Made the leaderboard navigation buttons easier to click, this will make navigating the leaderboard on mobile especially much easier.
- Fixed an issue that could sometimes cause the game to get stuck on a black screen right after running it from Steam.

notes.title: Patch - February 1, 2023
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue that prevented the Steam Overlay from working, players will now be able to open the overlay (shift-tab by default) and take screenshots (F12 by default) etc. 
- Fixed a bug in the Steam client that would have crashed the game when trying to paste a deck or replay. 
- Added sound for 19 minions that did not have sound yet.
- The previous nerfs to Scroll Bandit and Taegon the Citrine Dragon will now be globally applied (before it only affected Ladder and Gauntlet)
- Fixed issue with Aegis Golem were it's effect was undispellable.
- Fixed an issue with Thunderclap where the copy of an egg that was killed with it would never hatch.
- Fixed an issue with Spirit of the Wild where the animations might play twice if a battle pet was reactivated.
- Fixed an visual issue with Rift Beast where it's shadow was misaligned if it was under the control of player 2.
